name: keywright
description: MCP relay for the Keywright Roblox Studio animation plugin

scripts.build:plugin: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('build', { recursive: true })" && rojo build plugin/default.project.json -o build/Keywright.rbxm
scripts.build:fault: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('build', { recursive: true })" && rojo build plugin/fault.project.json -o build/KeywrightFault.rbxm
scripts.install:plugin: npm run build && npm run build:plugin && node dist/src/cli.js install-plugin
